turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

Go ahead. I'm going to the principal after this anyway, and I want that in writing. Two late assignments from September have nothing to do with this essay, and I'm writing down that you brought them up.

It was your call to enter the zero, Hale, and you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before you did. Procedure 4.2 says a parent gets contacted first, and nobody called me. What else do you have?
